about_the_game:
⌨️ Roguelike Typing Action Game

A roguelike typing action game that blends minimalist visuals with hard-hitting impact, Hello Cela. Join the girl “Cela” and overcome a mysterious adversary.

⌨️ High-Speed Action Through Typing

Attack, heal, buff. How fast and accurately you type the words on screen decides victory or defeat. Mistakes are not tolerated. Build an overwhelming combo before the enemy’s attack reaches you.

🃏 Strategic Deck-Building Roguelike

You won’t survive by typing mindlessly. After clearing each stage, choose one of three fates (cards) to craft your own combat style.

  • BERSERK: Will you abandon defense and triple your attack power?

  • VETERAN: Will you aim for the late game through steady growth?

  • ALL-IN-ONE: Will you boost the efficiency of every word to keep things balanced?

And that’s only a small part of it. Combine a wide variety of cards and adapt strategically to a battlefield that changes every run.

👻 Stylish Visuals and Unique Enemies

In a sleek art style where red and white collide, distinctive enemies like the “Seahorse” and “Vampire Bat” appear. Break through their different attack patterns that tighten around your fingers, and reach the end of this world.

Key Features (Features)

  • Real-time Typing Combat: Tense typing battles in real time, not turn-based.

  • Roguelite Elements: Random buff cards and skill upgrades for a fresh experience every run.

  • Combo System: A high-risk, high-reward system where uninterrupted input builds combos to trigger special buffs.

  • Boss Battles: Powerful bosses with gimmicks that go beyond simple typing.

  • Minimalist Art Style: Sleek visuals designed to keep you fully focused on gameplay.
